{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to float, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check if any such orders exist
print(f"Number of LOYAL completed orders: {len(loyal_completed)}")

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

print(f"Mean revenue of LOYAL completed orders: {mean_revenue}")"}
